buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG

Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/NCR/JHS A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF WORK 1. Scope of Work: The contractor shall provide one skilled and one semi-skilled person at each of the following stations under ADSTE/LAR, Jhansi Division: NLRT, BRRI, LPGCL, UDPR and TKMG, for a perio d of 12 months, as per the approved scope of work and schedule of rates. 2. Deployment of Manpower: The contractor shall deploy a total of 05 skilled and 05 semi-skilled pe rson, subject to the approved tender schedule. The personnel shall remain available at their respect ive stations and shall perform duties as directed by the authorized Railway representative. 3. Qualification and Experience: Skilled personnel shall possess ITI/Diploma or other relevant techn ical qualifications in the appropriate trade, as specified in the tender. Semi-skilled personnel shall p ossess the minimum educational qualification specified in the tender and shall be capable of assisti ng skilled personnel in maintenance activities. 4. Maintenance Activities: The deployed team shall assist Railway S&T staff in maintenance, upkee p and failure attention of Point Machines, Track Circuits, Signals, Axle Counters, cables, batteries, ch argers, transformers, location boxes and other S&T equipment, as directed by the authorized Railwa y representative. 5. Safety Precautions: All work shall be carried out under the supervision and authorization of Railway officials. The contractor's personnel shall strictly follow applicable Railway safety rules, instr uctions and precautions while working near railway tracks, points, signals and other operational inst allations. No safety-critical operation shall be undertaken independently by the contractor's personn el. 6. Tools and Equipment: The contractor shall arrange, at its own cost, the necessary tools, tackles, personal protective equipment (PPE), uniforms and other items required for the work, except materi als specifically agreed to be supplied by the Railway under the contract. 7. Communication Facility: The contractor shall provide each team with a functioning mobile phone and ensure effective communication with the concerned SSE/JE/S&T staff and the authorized Railwa y representative. Contact details of deployed personnel shall be furnished before commencement of work. 8. Attendance and Supervision: The contractor shall maintain daily attendance and station-wise de ployment records. These records shall be verified by the authorized Railway representative before c ertification of the monthly service performance and processing of bills. 9. Replacement of Personnel: In case of absence, resignation, leave or unsatisfactory performance of any deployed person, the contractor shall arrange a suitable replacement within the period presc ribed in the contract. Any applicable penalty for non-deployment or delayed replacement shall be i mposed as per the approved GeM contract/SLA. 10. Minimum Wages and Statutory Payments: The contractor shall pay wages not less than the ap plicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority. EPF, ESI, bonus, leave w ages and other statutory benefits shall be paid wherever applicable. Documentary proof of wage pa yment and statutory remittances shall be submitted as required by the contract. 11. Bank Payment of Wages: Wages shall be paid directly into the bank accounts of the deployed pe rsonnel through the prescribed banking channel. 12. Weekly Rest and Leave Relief: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for weekly rest, l eave and other absences in accordance with applicable labour laws and the approved manpower re quirement. No additional payment shall be admissible for such arrangements unless specifically pro vided in the contract. 13. Identity Cards and Verification: Before deployment, the contractor shall submit the list of perso nnel along with identity proof, address proof, qualification certificates and medical fitness document s, as required under the contract. Police verification shall be furnished wherever stipulated. All perso nnel shall carry valid contractor-issued identity cards while on Railway premises.

14. Uniform and Discipline: The contractor shall ensure that all deployed personnel wear the prescrib ed uniform and identity badge, maintain proper discipline and comply with the instructions of author ized Railway officials. Any personnel found unsuitable, negligent or guilty of misconduct shall be rep laced as per the contract conditions. 15. Emergency Duties: In the event of an S&T failure or emergency, the team shall assist Railway staf f at the locations specified by the competent authority, subject to the scope of work and applicable safety procedures. Any movement beyond the specified stations shall be governed by the contract provisions and instructions of the competent authority. 16. Transportation and Accommodation: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for trans portation, accommodation, food and other facilities for its personnel. No free transport, accommoda tion or other personal facilities shall be provided by the Railway unless specifically provided in the c ontract. 17. Protection of Railway Property: The contractor shall be responsible for loss or damage to Railwa y property attributable to the negligence or misconduct of its personnel, subject to assessment and recovery in accordance with the applicable contract conditions and rules. 18. Labour Law Compliance: The contractor shall comply with the applicable labour laws, statutory re gistrations, working-hour requirements, weekly rest provisions and other statutory obligations. The c ontractor shall be responsible for its employees and for maintaining all prescribed employment and wage records. 19. No Employer-Employee Relationship: The personnel deployed by the contractor shall remain e mployees of the contractor. Their deployment shall not create any employer-employee relationship with Indian Railways or confer any right to regular employment or absorption in Railway service. 20. Subletting: The contractor shall not assign or sublet the contract, wholly or partly, without prior wri tten permission wherever required under the applicable GCC and contract conditions. 21. Inspection and Performance Monitoring: The Railway administration may inspect attendance, d eployment, tools, safety compliance and the quality of assistance provided by the contractor's pers onnel. Deficiencies shall be rectified within the time stipulated by the authorized Railway representa tive. 22. Payment of Bills: Payment shall be made in accordance with the GeM contract terms against satis factory performance, certification by the authorized Railway representative and submission of presc ribed bills, attendance records, wage-payment proof and applicable statutory compliance document s. 23. Penalty for Deficiency: Penalties and recoveries for non-deployment, unauthorized absence, dela yed replacement, unsatisfactory performance or other contractual deficiencies shall be governed b y the applicable GeM SLA, GCC and approved tender conditions. 24. Applicable Conditions: These Special Conditions shall be read together with the approved GeM bi d, scope of work, GCC for Services, applicable SLA and relevant Railway instructions. In case of inco nsistency, the applicable contractual provisions and prevailing Railway/GeM rules shall govern. 6.
